name: Operation Mockingbird (Extended Claims)
claim: The CIA ran, and still runs, a comprehensive program controlling mainstream media.
description: Documented core: Church Committee findings and Carl Bernstein's 1977 reporting showed the CIA maintained relationships with hundreds of journalists during the Cold War. 'Mockingbird' as a formal, continuing, all-encompassing program is an extrapolation beyond the record; the name itself appears only for an unrelated small wiretap operation.
